source_verified_interpretation.invalid_size_policy: Current arms use size_representation=linear. invalid_size_policy=mask is a log-size TRAIN annotation/loss policy; no generated agent deletion occurs through it. Linear generated L/W remain raw finite values.
source_verified_interpretation.clipping: Accumulator clips each finite feature to source bin bounds before np.histogram. Every finite under/overflow remains represented in first/last bins rather than discarded; histogram mass equals feature count.
source_verified_interpretation.invalid_size_limit: Nonpositive dimensions would be included in first [0,.1)m bins, not removed. Exact nonpositive/under/overflow cannot be recovered from clipped bins; zero first shape bin proves there were no finite nonpositive size outputs for that audited feature/cell.
source_verified_interpretation.speed_limit: Physical scalar-speed output clamp_min0 can merge negative pre-output values at zero. The saved first [0,1)m/s bin cannot separate raw negative predictions, stationary and positive low speeds.
source_verified_interpretation.collision: All generated vehicle rows retained. Nonpositive linear widths could reduce geometric threshold without removing denominator rows; only first-bin upper bound can constrain that risk from these artifacts.
source_verified_interpretation.lat_angle: Only onroad vehicle subset measured, so lower lat/angle JSD still needs coverage gate; shape/speed are allvehicle distributions.
source_verified_interpretation.ranking: This coverage audit does not select or rerank any model/sampler; partial cells do not establish final conclusion.
